established_role_definition.hitter: one 400 PA season or two 300 PA seasons within two years
established_role_definition.pitcher: one 400 BF season or two 200 BF seasons within two years

guardrails.hitter_outcome_walk_field: total BB because the certified career backbone omits IBB; applied consistently to player and league rates
guardrails.positive_component_role_definition: at least 200 future MLB PA/BF in a season and at-least-league-average neutral batting wOBA components or fielding-independent pitching components
guardrails.quality_hurdle_factorization: P(meaningful role) multiplied later by P(positive components given meaningful role); conditional quality is scored only among players meeting the observed workload hurdle
